mapper.select: SELECT rp.role_id, p.id AS permission_id, p.code AS permission_code FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE p.status = 1
SELECT p.code FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status <> 2 ORDER BY p.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{permissionId}, #{operatorId}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
